title: Preferred Vendor Referral Terms — Commercial & Property Manager Service Agreements
content:
**Terms.** A referral is recorded only under a Carrier Preferred Vendor Agreement in active status. The carrier may refer only the loss types its agreement lists. For each referral the insured is contacted within the referral contact commitment hours, a crew is on site within the on-site commitment hours for an emergency loss, and the estimate is uploaded within the estimate upload days; a carrier whose quarterly scorecard falls below the scorecard minimum is reviewed by a human program manager. The referred loss is then handled as the insured's own jobs under a Carrier Program Claim Billing claim file.

These terms govern carrier referrals under the Commercial & Property Manager Service Agreements.

## Terms in detail

1. **Which agreement records referrals.** A referral is recorded only under a Carrier Preferred Vendor Agreement whose record shows active status. Each referral is recorded once per carrier referral number, with the date received, the loss type and whether the contact commitment was met.
2. **Referable losses.** The carrier may refer only the loss types its agreement lists.
3. **Commitments for each referral.**
   - the insured is contacted within the referral contact commitment hours;
   - for an emergency loss, a crew is on site within the on-site commitment hours;
   - the estimate is uploaded within the estimate upload days.
4. **Scorecard.** The carrier's quarterly scorecard is the percentage of its referrals in the quarter that met every commitment. A carrier whose quarterly scorecard falls below the scorecard minimum is reviewed by a human program manager.
5. **Handling of the referred loss.** The referred loss is then handled as the insured's own jobs under a Carrier Program Claim Billing claim file.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical referrals)

| Referral under | Loss type listed on the agreement? | Terms 1 and 2 satisfied? |
|---|---|---|
| a Carrier Preferred Vendor Agreement in active status | yes | yes |
| a Carrier Preferred Vendor Agreement in suspended or expired status | — | no |
| a Carrier Preferred Vendor Agreement in active status | no | no; the carrier may not refer that loss type |
| any other tier of agreement | — | no |
